description: 高雄市大寮區因應各項災害避難收容處所一覽表 [evacuation shelters and public facilities and disaster risk and hazard maps] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 高雄市大寮區公所. 高雄市大寮區因應各項災害避難收容處所一覽表資料. Coverage: 高雄市大寮區公所. The portal files it under the publisher 高雄市大寮區公所. Its tags are 生活安全及品質. It offers 1 resource(s) in json, csv. The portal shows 2025-09-24 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
